stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: Room for a family of six?
stations.note: A new party size at every turn.

stations.title: Noticeboard file
stations.text: A class for every rule, and none for this

stations.title: Your rules
stations.gap: No rule for a party's size

stations.title: Family
stations.say: Those two boats can take us all

captions: The ticket window. Bridie asks which boats have room for the family in front of her.
Today every rule is a class of its own, and the family's size has no rule at all.
You write the board's rules as lambdas, and one that keeps the size of each party.
Now the family of six hears in a moment which boats can take them all.
Rules in one line, made where they are needed. Next: the shapes Java already has.
